author: Kayla Walker
text: Absolutely great service received by the owner today. It was crazy cold and he came out and got it done quick. We have a toddler and he even let us watch him work because our toddler loves anything big truck related. Gave him a sticker after which he loved. Would definitely recommend to anyone we know!

author: Jon Cottun (Let's_Make_Sense)
text:
I don't ride bandwagons. There's a good reason why my high opinion of Lucas matches everyone else's reviews. We all hired him. He fixed my problem, saved me money, and he can hold a pretty decent conversation if you just can't help yourself. (By the way, when you call, you'll get Lucas, don't worry 😉)
Thanks man!

author: Michael Green
text: Lucas of Bracy’s A-1 Septic was great to work with. He communicated well, showed up for set appointment time, and fixed my issue in a timely manner, all while being reasonably priced. He showed me how to maintain properly to avoid issues in the future. I highly recommend him for anybody needing septic tank or Modad maintenance!

author: Rico Landry
text: Lucas with Bracy’s A-1 septic took my call at 9:00 am scheduled a 12:30 appointment and was backing in when I pulled in from work. He not only cleaned my tank but assisted me with a couple extras! Got me rolling in an hour!! Great service and outstanding attitude!  I highly recommend this service when needed!

author: Vicki Spruell
text: Very professional and explained everything he did.  He pumped my daughter’s septic and charged a very reasonable rate.  No problems with communication, he was very concerned about not tearing the yard up with the truck.  I have already recommended him to friends.  Excellent service!
